notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, players.

On 4/12 we updated a version with the following fixes.
1. Delete the Chinese in the installation folder and replace it with "Takame Girls-Initiating Station PLUS".
2. Use the built-in fonts to fix the problem that some players can't display some text or some fonts are not uniform.
3. Fix the bug that the left mouse button may crash when clicked continuously in some cases.

This week we will discuss solutions to the following problems: operating systems other than "Traditional Chinese, Taiwan" cannot start the game.
Players who encounter this problem are patient. Thank you.

notes.title: Fixed: Problems in full screen
notes.content:
Hello players

We just updated the game to solve the problem that the game cannot be started in full screen. After closing the game, please confirm that your software has been updated to the latest version by following these steps:

Right click on the name of the game list → "Contents"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36996885/09d9db8444b8c291c61880aeea8fb6c6783354f7.jpg[/img]

TAG "Local Files" → Verify the integrity of game files
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36996885/69be699425c6f6c8ea7fa0d98d6efff725b7cd8f.jpg[/img]

If there are items that need to be updated, a prompt will pop up.
Select "Update" to update to the latest version

The amendments are as follows:
1. Some specifications of the computer cannot start the game in full screen
2. An error in the text of Chapter 2

Next we expect to adjust the installation path to meet the needs of foreign language players
After the update will be announced again, thank you
